# Count songs per artist
from collections import Counter
artist_song_count = Counter()
for song_id, artist_ids in all_songs.items():
    for aid in artist_ids:
        artist_song_count[aid] += 1

# Get top 6 artist IDs by count, tie-break by artist_id for determinism
top_artists = sorted(artist_song_count.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:6]
